github.description: GitHub PR/review operations. No credential exists on this host; ships disabled until an owner decision provisions one and flips this flag — never invent or assume a credential.

list_pull_requests.description: List open pull requests for a repository.

get_pull_request_diff.description: Fetch the diff for a single pull request.

create_review_comment.description: Post a review comment on a pull request.

oth-knowledge.description: Read-only OTH Knowledge access, served by scripts/othk-serve.js over loopback with a bearer token. Declared here so a future OTH MCP client inherits THIS authorization model instead of inventing a second one; no connection detail belongs in this registry by design. Ships disabled: the facade is implemented and tested but not deployed, and enabling it is an owner decision recorded in Git. There is deliberately no write tool — OTH Knowledge ingestion and curation stay on the operator CLI path (projects/oth-knowledge/cli/othk-cli.js), which is what keeps a model-authored statement from ever becoming curated knowledge without a human.

search.description: Search curated knowledge. Bounded query and result count; returns records with provenance, never raw archive content.

retrieve.description: Fetch one knowledge record by id, with its version history and quarantine state.

provenance.description: Return the provenance chain of one record: source class, collection, reference, capture and truth times.

evidence.description: Return the evidence records supporting one claim or fact.

history.description: Return the version history of one record. Append-only; corrections supersede rather than erase.

entity.description: Look up an entity by name and list the records linked to it.

contradictions.description: List registered contradictions awaiting human resolution.

stats.description: Return record counts by kind. No content.

audit.description: Return the provenance audit summary, including quarantined records.
